title: Follower receives NS entries download Failed: NumberFormatException - Received Null
body:
Hi,

I have set up my NightScout account, and xDrip can write to it from the master device, but when setting up a following device, I receive the following -

NS entries download Failed:
com.google.gson.JsonSyntaxException:
java.lang.NumberFormatException: For input string: "Null"

The NightScout account was originally populated with entries by Diabox, but this stopped after a few hours, and I can't find a way of getting the details on a Wear OS watch. Hence why I'm trying xDrip. So there are gaps in the data, but I wouldn't expect that to cause an issue.

Thanks,

Brian

Are we sure this isn't the `noise` property causing issues. It's erroring because it's trying to convert the string `null` into an integer...
Nothing there other than an estimated missed number of readings and the estimated next read date

According to the JSON spec, a null value should be written as `null` and not `"null"`.

`A value can be a string in double quotes, or a number, or true or false or null, or an object or an array.`

 That is the cause of the problem. It has to be fixed at least twice: the upload should upload a valid value or `null` for the noise value, Nightscout should store and return it correctly and the Nightscout follower should be tolerant for `"null"` values to deal with existing data.
